pending.body: In `crates/tank_api/src/handlers/save.rs:23-24`, `post_load` accepts `Json<Value>`, serializes it to a String with `serde_json::to_string`, then `SaveFile::from_json` immediately parses that String back into a `Value`. This is a redundant round-trip (Value → String → Value). Add a `SaveFile::from_value(value: Value)` method that contains the migration/deserialization logic, and have `from_json` call it after the initial parse. Then `post_load` can call `from_value` directly, avoiding the unnecessary serialization step.

The `SimError::SchemaVersionMismatch { expected, actual }` variant in `crates/tank_core/src/types/actions.rs:72-73` is now dead code — no code path constructs it after the migration to `SchemaVersionTooNew` / `SchemaVersionTooOld`. It should be removed to prevent future contributors from accidentally using the wrong error variant.

`crates/tank_core/src/save.rs:117-121` truncates `schema_version` with `as u32` after reading it as `u64`. A save declaring a version larger than `u32::MAX` will wrap (for example `4294967296` becomes `0`) and `SaveFile::from_json` will report `SchemaVersionTooOld` instead of the required future-version error. Parse with `u32::try_from(...)` and reject out-of-range values explicitly so unknown future saves cannot be misclassified.
